page.overview:
Who is Guest?

A guest , or temporary party member, is a character in the Final Fantasy series who typically joins and leave the party during set points. Depending on the game guests may be controlled by the player or by AI, or may or may not allow the player to customize their equipment and abilities. Guests do not always take up space in the player's party, though they might appear in menus—if the game only allows for a certain amount of party members in battle, a guest can sometimes be additional to that.

Minwu, Josef, Ricard, Leila, and Gordon join the party for story-specific quests before leaving for a variety of reasons. The player may freely change their equipment and spells, but they join with preset abilities in a few key areas. In the "Soul of Rebirth" side story in the Dawn of Souls and subsequent versions (except the Pixel Remaster, which does not include it), Minwu, Josef, and Ricard are normal playable characters.

Guests are not treated as regular party members. In the original version, they can be spoken to by pressing a button while outside of battle, during which they will usually give some hint as to what to do next. In the 3D remake's battles, they appear at random to use a random ability from their set list of moves. The rest of the time, they will not appear and do not have HP or other stats that enemies can attack.

If the active party is defeated, the game ends in a Game Over, with or without the guests being still alive. Outside of battle, they can be spoken to with , the only method the player has to interact with them.
